summary: Assess corporate borrowers, repayment capacity, and credit risk with applied case work. Explore the 5-day course outline and enrol.
lede: Corporate credit analysis evaluates a borrower’s financial position and ability to repay, supporting informed lending decisions. It is designed for credit analysts, relationship managers and portfolio risk professionals who assess corporate borrowers, monitor exposures or prepare lending recommendations. Participants practise financial-statement and cash-flow assessment, repayment scenario testing, and documenting risk ratings and lending decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who evaluate corporate borrowers, prepare lending recommendations, monitor exposures, or review credit portfolios.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of basic financial statements and lending or credit processes is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a calculator or spreadsheet-capable laptop for ratio and cash-flow exercises.
